title: NAME OF THE SHEET
sub: The six, in one line: what to lead and the sets to train.
leads_intro: Pick the lead at team preview, then the turn-one line for what they send out. Percentages are how often to click each line; use any randomizer. The two numbers are your win chance after turn one against how the Showdown ladder clicks, then against a player who reads your mix; red means the lead loses turn one.

Each tab shows the four to bring: the lead and back row that won the most whole-game sims against that archetype (both sides switching, every turn played out, endgames included). Its lines are the turn-one plan for that lead.
leads_method: The lead and back row shown won the most whole-game sims: full 4v4 battles in a native port of Showdown’s engine, both sides playing each turn’s best mix (switches included) to the end, against the archetype’s six most common leads with the back rows they bring in 5,000 Showdown M-C Bo3 replays. Every four of the six was tried, and the leaders were replayed head to head on fresh games. The turn-one lines were run with 12 RNG samples per cell in Showdown’s engine with Champions mechanics and scored with a win model fit on 7,781 games. Their Indeedee F’s item is mixed at replay rates: Rocky Helmet 48%, Colbur Berry 32%, Psychic Seed 20%. Their other leads are not simulated.
team_intro: Stat points (SP) are what you assign in the game; the stat row is the result at level 50, after Mega Evolution for the Mega.
footer: Damage. The leads were simulated in Showdown’s own engine with Champions mechanics.
